name: Pilot Render [Combat]
body:
What mech pilots tend not to realize is how fragile their control really is.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Dirty Trick, Disable Device 1 rank

Benefit(s): When you use the dirty trick combat maneuver on a mech, you may choose to impose a disrupted condition on the mech rather than the normal conditions available. While disrupted, the pilot is unable to do anything to control their mech. This condition lasts as long as other dirty trick conditions and can be removed in the same way.
